intro.heading: Rooted in community.
body: Heartfelt gatherings in the desert. That's the work — somebody cooks, everybody sits down, and a few hours later nobody wants to leave.
We're a woman-owned catering company in Joshua Tree. Local ingredients, cooked by hand, never locked into a single cuisine.
Connection through food is the whole point. The menu is just how we get there.

services.heading: What we offer
services.intro: Dinner for eight in your rental, or a hundred people in a backyard. Same kitchen, same hands, same care either way.
services._PLACEHOLDER: Descriptions are drafts — confirm each service is accurate before launch.

items.name: Private Chef
items.description: We cook in your kitchen — your house, your rental, wherever you're staying. Courses come out when they're ready, and you get to sit down for all of them. Usually eight to twenty people around one table.

items.name: Event Catering
items.description: Weddings, birthdays, anniversaries, the big backyard nights. We cook on site, serve, and clean up after, so you can be a guest at your own party. Menus are built around your guest list, not pulled off a shelf.

items.name: Production Catering
items.description: Cast and crew meals for shoots working out here. We'll work to your budget and your call sheet, feed everyone properly, and keep it moving. Dietary needs handled without a fuss.

items.name: Meal Prepping
items.description: Cooked, portioned, and delivered with reheating instructions. Right for a house full of people over a long weekend, or a week you'd rather not spend cooking.

items.name: Retreat Meals
items.description: Multi-day cooking for groups staying out in the desert. Breakfast before everyone scatters, packed lunches for the day, dinner when they come back hungry. We plan the whole arc so nobody's thinking about food.

services.pricingNote: Every menu is written for the event, so every quote is too. Tell us the date, the headcount, and what you're picturing — we'll send a menu and a price built around it. No fixed packages, no per-plate list.

about.heading: About
about.lede: Joshua Tree Catering Co. is a woman-owned company in Joshua Tree, California. Local ingredients, cooked by hand, never locked into a single cuisine.
body: Connection through food is the whole point. The menu is just how we get there.
A focus on community means fresh, local ingredients and working with local growers and makers wherever we can. We keep waste down and choose sustainable practices across the business.

Chef Kristi was born and raised in Southern California and comes from a line of cooks. Her love of food and community started in her grandmother's bakery, where she learned technique alongside her grandma and saw first-hand how a small food business holds a neighborhood together. At home it was the same. Every gathering was built around the kitchen, and that's still how she cooks — for the room, not the plate.
We believe food is a universal language, and being part of this community's table is an honor. Somebody cooks, everybody sits down, and a few hours later nobody wants to leave.
